title: Warrior in Ruined Temple
description: A muscular male warrior with long flowing green hair and purple energy wings is viewed from behind, standing in a destroyed temple. He holds a massive ornate demonic sword that drips red liquid, surrounded by swirling smoke, red chains, and floating embers.
prompt: A powerful muscular male warrior seen from behind with long flowing green hair in a high ponytail, purple energy wings, and glowing golden tattoos on his bare back. He stands in a destroyed ancient temple with red pillars, holding a gigantic ornate demonic sword that drips red blood. Swirling white smoke, red chains, floating embers, and dramatic purple lighting fill the scene.
